description: Pure Python library module exposing external-intelligence context to the directive generator's Layer 1. Reads two mesh-side sources: (1) world_agent article_insights from mesh_memory via write_service POST /query, and (2) the most recent wisdom_synthesiser briefing from /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/SYSTEM_WISDOM.md on disk. Scores article_insights with a keyword-weighted relevance function and returns a compact prompt-ready markdown section. Weighting: MCP-related terms score 3 (substrings: 'mcp', 'model context protocol', 'model-context-protocol'); supply-chain/package-attack terms score 2 ('supply chain', 'supply-chain', 'typosquat', 'typo squat', 'malicious package', 'malicious npm', 'malicious pypi', 'package compromise', 'rug pull', 'rug-pull', 'prompt injection', 'tool poisoning'); general AI/agent/security terms score 1 ('ai agent', 'agentic', 'llm', 'model release', 'inference', 'api key', 'spyware', 'zero-day', 'cve', 'vulnerability', 'threat actor', 'apt', 'c2', 'command and control', 'ransomware'). Scoring is case-insensitive substring match on the title plus first 500 chars of the insight JSON. An insight with score 0 is dropped. Module exposes FIVE things: (a) MCP_KEYWORDS, SUPPLY_CHAIN_KEYWORDS, GENERAL_KEYWORDS as tuples of lowercase strings; (b) score_insight(insight_row: dict) -> tuple[int, dict] returning (total_score, {'matched': {keyword: count}, 'tier_hits': {3: n, 2: n, 1: n}}); (c) fetch_recent_article_insights(hours: int = 48, limit: int = 50) -> list[dict] that calls write_service /query with a parameterized SELECT on mesh_memory filtered by agent_id='t1.world_agent' and memory_type='article_insight' and created_at > now - hours, returning raw rows; (d) load_latest_wisdom_briefing(max_chars: int = 1500) -> str|None that reads SYSTEM_WISDOM.md and returns the contents truncated to max_chars, or None if the file is missing or stale (>48h old); (e) build_intel_map_section(hours: int = 48, top_n: int = 5, wisdom_max_chars: int = 1500) -> str that orchestrates all the above and returns a markdown-formatted block suitable for direct injection into the directive_gen prompt. The markdown block MUST start with '## External Intelligence Map (recency <=Nh)' and contain subsections: '### Top-ranked article insights' listing the top_n scored insights with score, title, first 400 chars of insight, source tag [world_agent]; '### Latest wisdom synthesiser briefing' with the SYSTEM_WISDOM.md content tagged [wisdom_synthesiser]; '### Scope reminder' with one line: 'Items above are ambient intelligence. Not every relevant news item requires a directive. Only propose directives when the intel surfaces a NEW detection artefact, threat feed, or registry that Sentinel does not yet ingest -- per SENTINEL_SCOPE_BOUNDARY.md decision rule.' Implementation constraints: uses requests module with a strict 10-second write_service timeout and a try/except that returns an empty-but-structured section on failure (never raises, never blocks directive_gen). Uses post_with_retry from http_retry if available at import time; falls back to plain requests.post if import fails. Parameterized SQL only -- never interpolate hours or other values into the SQL string. No DB writes. No network calls beyond the local write_service. No imports of protected modules. Module-level compiled regex is NOT needed; keyword matching is simple substring. Include an if __name__ == '__main__' block that calls build_intel_map_section(hours=48, top_n=3) and prints the result so 'python3 sentinel_intel_feed.py' shows a real rendering. The self-test must exit 0 if write_service is reachable OR return a graceful empty section if not. Attribution in module docstring: mention this library feeds ambient intelligence (not build directives) into directive_knowledge_sources.assemble_layer1_context; wiring is a follow-up directive, not this one. Reference SENTINEL_SCOPE_BOUNDARY.md in the docstring so the scope discipline is visible to future readers.
context: This directive extends Layer 1 of the directive generator (see directive_knowledge_sources.assemble_layer1_context). It produces a fifth context section ('intel_map') the generator can consume. Current Layer 1 surfaces product_spec, wiring_map, gaps_map, quality_map -- all inward-looking. External intelligence from t1.world_agent (428+ article_insights) and wisdom_synthesiser (SYSTEM_WISDOM.md) is written to mesh_memory and disk but never reaches the directive prompt. This module closes that gap. DO NOT modify directive_knowledge_sources.py in this directive -- wiring is a separate follow-up directive so this library lands and smokes cleanly before being consumed. Existing mesh_memory schema observed 2026-04-22: agent_id (text), memory_type (text), content (text), importance (real), created_at (timestamptz); content is JSON-encoded dict with title and insight keys for article_insight rows. write_service /query endpoint accepts {'sql': str, 'params': list} and returns {'rows': [...]}. See signal_bridge.py for a working example of ws_query with parameterized SQL against mesh_memory.
